User Management
System Users
Access Level Guide
AdminFull access
Can do everything: manage users, view salaries, offboard employees, access all analytics.
HRPeople management
Add employees, log events, manage onboarding & offboarding, view salaries, assign training.
ManagerView + limited actions
View employees and events, log events for their team. Cannot view salaries or manage offboarding.
ViewerRead-only
Can only view the dashboard, employees list, and training status. No editing allowed.
